study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter prospective cohort study
exposure: Social determinants of health (insurance status, race, ethnicity, income, marital status, primary language, education)
cohort: 9,457 nulliparous participants from a large, multicenter prospective cohort study
finding: While a higher frequency of postpartum readmission was observed in nulliparous individuals with HDP, social determinants of health were not associated with postpartum readmission in either those with or without HDP.
